ACT IX OF 1995
ACT IX OF 1995
SUGAR FACTORIES CONTROL (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act to amend the Sugar
Factories Control Act, 1950 as applicable to Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 25th October, 1995]
No. PAS/Legis-B-16/95, dated
25-10-1995.--The Sugar Factories Control (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 1995 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 20th September, 1995 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 8th October, 1995 is hereby published
as an Act of the legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Sugar Factories Control (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Insertion of section 17-A of Act No. XXII of 1950

ACT IX OF 1995
ACT IX OF 1995
SUGAR FACTORIES CONTROL (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act to amend the Sugar
Factories Control Act, 1950 as applicable to Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 25th October, 1995]
No. PAS/Legis-B-16/95, dated
25-10-1995.--The Sugar Factories Control (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 1995 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 20th September, 1995 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 8th October, 1995 is hereby published
as an Act of the legislature of Sindh.
2. Insertion of section 17-A of Act No. XXII of 1950.--In the Sugar
Factories Control Act, 1950 as applicable to Sindh after section 17, the
following new section shall be inserted:--
"17-A.
Compulsory installation of Core sampler.---Every factory established after
the commencement of the Sugar Factories Control (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1995,
shall install a core sampler of the specification and in the manner as may be
prescribed. "
